build_note: Deterministic S2.11 / G0.5 corrective decision capsule v6; every state judgment is re-derived from current on-disk assets, manifests, hashes or executed independent verifiers. v5's full audit WAS green (final receipt 2118 passed / 24 skipped / 19 warnings in 941.91s) and v5 is NOT a red checkpoint; its historical events stay preserved. However v5's caller-supplied validation-result protection was OVERTURNED by v6 counterexamples: a hand-built dict with a well-formed 64-hex token and the correct frozen hash could unlock classify_frozen. v6 removes the validation-result parameter entirely: classify_frozen re-verifies the draft/frozen configs, the authorization manifest, the append-only authorization event and the prior-results evidence scan from disk raw bytes on every call; prior results are derived from disk evidence (never a caller bool); the authorization manifest must fully bind the approved scope/sentence/event/checkpoint. v6 also adds adapter formal_evidence_provenance (re-verified evidence context, controlled scope enums, resolved-path containment) and fixes the historical capsule anchors to the v3/v4/v5 ORIGIN COMMITS (hardcoded SHA-256 maps, independent of HEAD). Article license CC BY 4.0 (article-only) stays separated from artifact code/data license (unknown_pending_confirmation); G0.5 stays draft_not_frozen and its authorization hash domain is the raw file bytes; G4 authorizes only a future gate-application checkpoint; G5 is not authorization-ready; authorization sentences are DRY-RUN text, nothing is applied, no gate is flipped and no Gold is created.

v6_counterexamples: hand-built validation result {frozen_application_valid: True, validation_token: <any 64 lowercase hex>, approved_frozen_config_sha256: <real frozen hash>} -> REJECTED: classify_frozen has NO validation-result parameter; it re-verifies the full chain from disk on every call
validation token copied from another authorization manifest -> REJECTED: the token is re-derived from THIS manifest's raw bytes
manifest modified after validation (stale token reuse) -> REJECTED: re-validation hashes the CURRENT manifest/event bytes
manifest bound to a different draft/frozen config (path or raw-byte hash mismatch) -> REJECTED: G05_FROZEN_APPLICATION_MANIFEST_BINDING

authorization sentence / scope / event / event-path replaced -> REJECTED: G05_FROZEN_APPLICATION_SENTENCE_MISMATCH / SCOPE_MISMATCH / EVENT_MISMATCH (exact approved sentence + scope enum + event raw bytes required)
results produced BEFORE the authorization files -> REJECTED: prior results are derived from the project root by deterministic path/manifest rules (derive_prior_results), never from a caller bool

caller claims verified with bare booleans or forged hashes -> REJECTED: only on-disk re-verification of the manifest + append-only event counts; a content hash proves byte-identity only, never user authorization
G0.5 hash-domain mismatch: the raw-byte config hash 61938c99… is the only authorization hash; the semantic re-serialization hash 51a6e4fe… is rejected
adapter formal evidence scope mismatch (article_only does NOT cover artifact code/data) -> LICENSE_SCOPE_NOT_ARTIFACT_COVERING; resolved-path (symlink/junction) escape -> EVIDENCE_PATH_ESCAPE
